screens.title: Links, read
screens.why: A link on its own line is drawn as a card: picture, title, site.

pins.label: A row of its own
pins.text: The card is a paragraph, as wide as the notes. The page's picture on the left, its title (2 lines), then the site in ink3.

pins.label: Tap opens outside
pins.text: The whole card is one tap to the browser, outside the app. Arrow-up-right (Phosphor) says it leaves.

pins.label: Saved as text
pins.text: In the notes the card is just the link on its own line: the server, the agent and the other brand read a URL. Title and picture are kept by the server, read once.

screens.title: Pasting a link
screens.why: Paste, and it is a loading card at once; the cursor moves under it.

pins.label: Loading card
pins.text: Just pasted: the picture and two title bars pulse (fillStrong to a touch of ink3), the host already shown under them. Title and picture take their place when the server answers; a link it cannot read keeps its URL as the title (screen 4).

pins.label: Cursor goes under
pins.text: Pasting, or pressing return after a typed link, makes the card and puts the cursor on the line below. Typing beside a card moves to a line of its own.

screens.title: Backspace on a card
screens.why: The cursor right after a card rings it; one backspace removes it.

pins.label: Ring = next to go
pins.text: With the cursor right after the card, it gets an accent ring: one backspace takes the card and its line. So does backspace at the start of the line under it.

screens.title: Nothing to show
screens.why: A link with no picture, or that could not be read, still is a card.

pins.label: No picture
pins.text: The link icon in a fillStrong tile, the title as read.

pins.label: Not readable
pins.text: Private or broken: the link itself as the title, for good, and still one tap to open.

screens.title: After backspace
screens.why: The card's paragraph goes with it; the text closes up.

pins.label: Line and card gone
pins.text: No empty line left behind. Undo is the keyboard's. Same rules in a project's notes (one controller for both).
